args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (summary_outlier), 3 runs:
- r07: REGR peak 53.09 %/h against a batch median of 0.37 (z 1185). Growth zone 695 µm against 52.5 (z 41). Flank difference -8.36 %/h (z -18.8).
- r01 and r08: the largest flank difference is at 84 µm against a median of 331.5 µm (z -10.8), and it is negative (-0.47 %/h). The REGR peak is 0.72 %/h, about twice the median (z 7.9).
Cleared, 5 runs: r02, r03, r04, r05, r06. All checks pass, every |z| is 1.32 or less, and no remedies were kept. r05 took 4 steps but ended on default settings.
What the flagged runs share: all three checks pass, each run took one step, and none kept a remedy or had a roll back. Each was flagged because its strain-rate profile has a different shape from the batch: in r07 a much longer growth zone, in r01 and r08 the flank difference near the tip and of the opposite sign. So the checks did not catch these faults; only the comparison with the batch did.
Note: some records are identical. r01 matches r08, r03 matches r04, and r02, r05 and r06 match each other in checks and summaries. Check whether these are copies of one measurement rather than separate roots.
